name: newunicodechar
caption: Definitions of the meaning of Unicode characters

descriptions.text:
The package provides a friendly interface for defining the meaning of Unicode characters. The document should be processed by (pdf)LaTeX with the unicode option of inputenc or inputenx, or by XeLaTeX/LuaLaTeX. The command provided is

\newunicodechar{<char>}{<code>}

where <char> is a directly-typed Unicode character, and <code> is its replacement.
